component.name: TFStudio
component.summary: Optical thin-film coating design and analysis

description.p: TFStudio is a desktop application for designing and analyzing optical thin-film coatings: antireflection coatings, mirrors, beamsplitters, bandpass and edge filters, and more. It provides a double-precision optical engine, refinement and synthesis algorithms, and an analysis suite, in a docked, multi-window interface.
